newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Boeing holds conference for Chinese 737 operators.
newsitem.headline: Boeing holds conference for Chinese 737 operators.

text.p: The Boeing Company said it opened a two day technical conference for China's Boeing 737 operators to improve airline safety and efficiency, according to a Boeing press release.

The 737 engineering and maintenance conference in Beijing is designed to keep China's airlines and the governing body, the Civil Aviation Authority of China (CAAC) up to date on important technical issues. More than 150 airline representatives, CAAC officials and suppliers are attending the conference which Boeing is hosting for the second year in a row, Boeing said.
China has one of the world's largest 737 fleets with 135 aircraft flown by 17 operators throughout China, Boeing said. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
